name: Cold Hearths
description: A settlement of hearths with no houses around them. Each is a ring of stone with a fire pit at the centre, spaced at regular intervals across open ground, and every pit is cold and swept. People lived here and the living has been taken away.

pois.label: Swept fire pit
pois.text: Ash gone, stone floor of the pit visible, and swept in a spiral. Sweeping a fire pit is not something anyone does, and every pit here has been swept the same way.

pois.label: Even spacing
pois.text: Walk between two hearths and count it off. Every gap is the same. Whatever set them out worked to a measure and kept to it.

pois.label: Cold ring
pois.text: The stones are cold and dry and there is no soot on the inner faces. Not banked, not raked out, just cold, as if the fire was lifted away whole.
